propositions.name: stagnant_aether_defines_rest
propositions.statement: There is a stagnant æther with respect to which the space of reference for the electrodynamic equations is fixed.
propositions.quote: let the space of reference be fixed with respect to the stagnant æther, and ( p, q, r ) be the velocity with which the matter situated at the point ( x, y, z ) is moving

propositions.name: newton_framework_is_aether
propositions.statement: The spacial framework in absolute rest introduced by Newton is in fact the quiescent underlying æther.
propositions.quote: the spacial framework in absolute rest, which was introduced by Newton and was probably a main source of the great advance in abstract dynamics originated by the Principia , is in fact the quiescent underlying æther

propositions.name: definite_space_required
propositions.statement: A definite space or spacial framework fixed or moving, to which motion is referred, is a necessary part of any dynamical theory.
propositions.quote: The objection that rotational elasticity postulates absolute directions in space need hardly have weight when it is considered that a definite space, or spacial framework fixed or moving, to which motion is referred, is a necessary part of any dynamical theory.

propositions.name: absolute_space_time_underlie_dynamics
propositions.statement: No system of dynamics can be constructed which has respect only to the relative positions of moving bodies, so an underlying æthereal medium must play the role of absolute space and time.
propositions.quote: Whatever notions may commend themselves a priori as to the impossibility of absolute space and absolute time, the fact remains that it has not been found possible to construct a system of dynamics

propositions.name: kinetic_energy_needs_external_framework
propositions.statement: Kinetic energy is specified in terms of the rate of change of configuration of the material system with respect to an extraneous spacial framework to which its position is referred.
propositions.quote: the kinetic part, which is specified in terms of the rate of change of configuration of the material system with respect to an extraneous spacial framework to which its position is referred

propositions.name: aether_continuous_incompressible
propositions.statement: The æther is a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium endowed with inertia and with elasticity purely rotational.
propositions.quote: the various hypotheses involved in the theory of electric and optical phenomena, which has been developed by Faraday and Maxwell , can be systematized by assuming the æther to be a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium

propositions.name: medium_transmits_in_time
propositions.statement: A medium, in order to be available at all, must transmit actions across it in time, and thus must be endowed with inertia and elasticity.
propositions.quote: A medium, in order to be available at all, must transmit actions across it in time ; therefore there must be postulated for it the property of inertia

propositions.name: propagation_needs_inertia_elasticity
propositions.statement: Propagation of ray-vibrations in time requires inertia and elasticity of the free æther for its mathematical expression.
propositions.quote: This propagation in time requires inertia and elasticity for its mathematical expression, and the problem of the free æther is to find what kind of each is requisite.

propositions.name: electrons_are_singularities
propositions.statement: Electrons exist as point-singularities or centres of intrinsic strain in the æther which can move about under their mutual actions.
propositions.quote: In this medium unitary electric charges, or electrons, exist as point-singularities, or centres of intrinsic strain, which can move about under their mutual actions

propositions.name: matter_is_electron_aggregation
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion.
propositions.quote: atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion. In particular, this scheme provides an consistent foundation for the electrodynamic laws

propositions.name: ascertained_velocity_of_radiation
propositions.statement: There is a definite ascertained velocity of radiation, and the coefficient of inertia and elasticity of the æther must be chosen to conserve it.
propositions.quote: we have been compelled to assume a high coefficient of inertia of the medium, and therefore an extremely high elasticity in order to conserve the ascertained velocity of radiation

propositions.name: sole_spatial_relations_of_aether
propositions.statement: The sole spacial relations of the æther on which its dynamics depend are incompressibility and rotational elasticity, alongside the Euclidean relations of measurements in space.
propositions.quote: The sole spacial relations of the æther itself, on which its dynamics depend, those namely of incompressibility and rotational elasticity

propositions.name: maxwell_equations_verified
propositions.statement: Maxwell's equations of the electric field in free space form a sufficient description of the free æther and have been verified by experiment.
propositions.quote: they may be based directly on Maxwell 's equations of the electric field in free space , which form a sufficient description of the free æther, and have been verified by experiment

propositions.name: instantaneous_gravitation_pulses
propositions.statement: The pulsation postulated for gravitation is instantaneously communicated throughout the incompressible æther from its outside boundary to the vacuous nuclei of the electrons.
propositions.quote: we can (ideally) imagine the pulsation to have been applied initially over the outside boundary of the æthereal universe, and thence instantaneously communicated throughout the incompressible medium

propositions.name: instantaneous_intrinsic_magnetic_force
propositions.statement: The electron's intrinsic magnetic force must be instantaneously transmitted, because any delay in transmission would involve condensation of the incompressible medium.
propositions.quote: the electron is not only a centre of steady intrinsic electric force, but also a centre of alternating intrinsic magnetic force, instantaneously transmitted because it would otherwise involve condensation

propositions.name: pulsations_keep_time_and_phase
propositions.statement: Once initiated, the gravitational pulsations spontaneously keep time and phase ever after even when the exciting cause has been discontinued.
propositions.quote: we can even imagine the pulsations thus established as spontaneously keeping time and phase ever after, when the exciting cause which established this harmony has been discontinued.

propositions.name: gravitation_belongs_to_electrons
propositions.statement: Gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, that is to the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them.
propositions.quote: As gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, that is on this theory to the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them

propositions.name: steady_state_needs_permanent_configuration
propositions.statement: For a steady state without conduction currents the configuration of the matter must be permanent and its motion the same at all times relative to itself and to the æther.
propositions.quote: the configuration of the matter shall be permanent, and that its motion shall be the same at all times relative to this configuration and to the æther

propositions.name: conductor_electric_force_vanishes
propositions.statement: Inside a conductor in steady motion the electric force must vanish, otherwise electric separation would go on.
propositions.quote: Inside a conductor the electric force must vanish, otherwise electric separation would be going on, therefore V must there be constant.

propositions.name: free_charge_carried_with_matter
propositions.statement: In a steady state, the electrons constituting electric densities are wholly carried on by the moving matter, as in Rowland's classical experiments on convection currents.
propositions.quote: the electrons constituting electric densities being wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained. This necessary consequence of the theory is in keeping with Rowland's classical experiments on convection currents.

propositions.name: convective_time_derivative_operator
propositions.statement: The time derivative following the moving matter is the sum of the derivative with respect to time in the æther frame and the velocity components of the matter times the coordinate derivatives.
propositions.quote: let the space of reference be fixed with respect to the stagnant æther, and ( p, q, r ) be the velocity with which the matter situated at the point ( x, y, z ) is moving

propositions.name: auxiliary_time_variable
propositions.statement: Changing the time variable from t to t' = t - vx/c² is a mathematical device that brings the equations for the moving system into the form of an electric scheme for a crystalline medium at rest.
propositions.quote: becomes d/dx , and d/dt becomes d/dt', and these equations assume the form of an electric scheme for a crystalline medium at rest.

propositions.name: positional_difference_of_time_reckoning
propositions.statement: Electrons situated less advanced in the direction of v are relatively very slightly further on in their orbits on account of the difference of time-reckoning between the two systems.
propositions.quote: while those less advanced in the direction of v are also relatively very slightly further on in their orbits on account of the difference of time-reckoning.

propositions.name: body_shrunk_along_motion
propositions.statement: A material body in uniform motion through the æther is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio 1 - ½ v²/c².
propositions.quote: one consequence of the motion thus being that the body is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio

propositions.name: electron_orbits_slowed
propositions.statement: The individual electrons of the moving system describe corresponding parts of their orbits in times shorter than the correlative system at rest in the æther.
propositions.quote: the individual electrons describe corresponding parts of their orbits in times shorter for the latter system in the ratio

propositions.name: corresponding_states_persist
propositions.statement: If two æthereal systems are set free at any instant in corresponding states, they will be in corresponding states at each subsequent instant.
propositions.quote: if these two æthereal systems are set free at any instant in corresponding states, they will be in corresponding states at each subsequent instant

propositions.name: conductor_shape_alters_with_motion
propositions.statement: Conductors change their actual forms to a slight extent depending on (v/c)² when they are put in motion.
propositions.quote: change their actual forms to a slight extent depending on (v/c)² when they are put in motion

propositions.name: contraction_confirms_michelson_null
propositions.statement: The contraction argument confirms the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz put forward to explain the negative result of Michelson's optical experiments.
propositions.quote: If this argument is valid, it will confirm the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz , to which they were led as the ultimate resource for the explanation of the negative result of Michelson 's optical experiments

propositions.name: molecule_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented.
propositions.quote: it will involve evidence that the constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented.

propositions.name: no_mechanical_force_at_atomic_level
propositions.statement: In the complete survey of the individual atoms there is no such entity as mechanical force; mechanical forces enter only at the level of molecular aggregates considered as continuous bodies.
propositions.quote: in the present complete survey of the individual atoms there is no such entity as mechanical force, any more than there is on a free vortex ring in fluid

propositions.name: geometrical_strain_of_space
propositions.statement: A geometrical strain of the moving system and its surrounding space by the factor ε^½ along the direction of motion converts the field equations into an isotropic form for a system at rest.
propositions.quote: We can restore the above characteristic equation of V, the potential of the electric force, to an isotropic form by a geometrical strain of the system and the surrounding space

propositions.name: very_slight_rotational_displacements
propositions.statement: Because of the assumed high elasticity of the æther, the very strongest electric forces correspond to only very slight rotational displacements of the medium.
propositions.quote: the very strongest electric forces correspond to only very slight rotational displacements of the medium

propositions.name: steady_state_uniform_spiral_motion
propositions.statement: For a steady state to hold, the motion of the matter is confined to uniform spiral motion on a definite axis fixed in the æther.
propositions.quote: this confines it to uniform spiral motion on a definite axis fixed in the æther. Referring to axes fixed in the material system, the vector potential has in the steady motion no time-variation

propositions.name: action_and_reaction_from_energy
propositions.statement: The energy principle involves the principle of the balance of action and reaction, so any displacement of two systems as a single rigid system can involve no expenditure of work.
propositions.quote: the resultant forcive exerted by the first system on the second must statically equilibrate that exerted by the second system on the first, these forcives must in fact be equal and opposite wrenches on a common axis
